scope: Successor local Q-017 observability tranche. Final stdout scalars add snapshots and rank-local high-water marks for a bounded set of device-addressable Kokkos view spans owned by AthenaK: direct Particles views, particle migration helpers, moment-boundary helpers, and MeshRefinement AMR/load-balance helpers where those allocations are visible at owned architecture boundaries. This is not a total GPU-memory, allocator-residency, or temporally concurrent multi-rank peak claim.

tracked_storage: ParticlesBoundaryValues migration send, destroy, and MPI buffer device-view spans plus temporary device counters while live
MeshBoundaryValues moment and edge-current boundary device-view spans
MeshRefinement interpolation, AMR/load-balance, and particle-redistribution device-view spans
MeshRefinement particle-remapping transient device-view spans while they remain observable in CreateParticleLists
excluded_storage: Kokkos runtime allocator overhead and cached allocations
device allocations owned outside the tracked Particles, boundary, and MeshRefinement objects
host-only STL vectors, host-only arrays, and MPI request arrays
a temporally concurrent aggregate multi-rank peak
telemetry_contract.rank_semantics: allocated_snapshot_bytes_total is a final concurrent rank sum. allocated_high_water_bytes_rank_sum is the sum of independent rank-local high-water marks and is deliberately not named total or peak.
telemetry_contract.sampling_semantics: High-water samples are taken while particle migration send and destroy lists plus temporary counters remain live, after owned particle migration helper calls, after owned AMR/load-balance persistent reallocations, after particle-array growth during AMR redistribution, and while CreateParticleLists transient device views remain alive. Final output also compares against the current tracked snapshot.
